h: Shabbos Rest and Unity Silence the Accusation of Amalek

p: "Outside they remain and do not enter,
The kelipah of Amalek is called a dog,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סה, א)
for it is a barking dog
"Who happened upon you on the way":
that he came by way of happenstance;
came by providence from Hashem Yisbarach,
the Holy One, blessed is He, revealed
and likewise the exile of Ashur:
although the Ten Tribes were assimilated,
he comes of his own accord
Hashem Yisbarach to remove His providence
as they said the parable in the Midrash
And this is "who happened upon you."
And this is what they said
"Like one who came in at night, etc.,
to remind that friend of his
זְכוֹר אֵיךְ פִּשַּׁרְתִּי מִמְּךָ אֶת הַכֶּלֶב
Remember how I released the dog from you!
Remember what you did at Refidim, etc.;
זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק
Remember what Amalek did to you."
לָמָּה לֹא הִזְכִּיר לָהֶם אֶת הַחֵטְא
why did He not remind them of the sin?
Was not the sin of the Calf more severe,
זָכוֹר וְגוֹ׳ אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִקְצַפְתָּ וְגוֹ׳
there was no sin at all
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
If so, why were they punished?
And they did not deserve punishment,
Hashem Yisbarach removed His providence from them,
and through this the punishment came,
as they said in the Midrash (Esther Rabbah 8:5),
בֶּן בְּנוֹ שֶׁל קָרְהוּ בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם
"The grandson of 'who happened upon you' has come upon you";
for in truth there was upon them
as for their bowing to the image,
they were not obligated to give up their lives
and likewise their enjoying his feast
for on the contrary, at that feast
the holiness of Yisrael was made clear
as they said in the Gemara (Megillah 12b).
arouses the root of the kelipah of the serpent,
and because of this the punishment came.
the grandson of "who happened upon you,"
וְכֵן מָצִינוּ בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And so we find with Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
when he said to his sons,
"My son shall not go down with you, etc.,
וּקְרָאָהוּ אָסוֹן בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְגוֹ׳ (בְּרֵאשִׁית מב, לח)
and should disaster befall him on the way, etc." (Bereishis 42:38);
and it is stated (in Bereishis Rabbah 91:9):
only at a time of danger."
That is: when one needs rescue,
אַךְ מִכָּל מָקוֹם הוּא בָּא עַל חֵטְא
Yet nevertheless it comes because of sin,
"At the gate of the stall, words;
and at the threshing floor, the accounting."
Only that from the sin alone
he would not have deserved punishment,
but when he is in a place of danger
That is why it says there
"kera'ahu" with both an aleph and a heh;
indicates the Master of the world
that is, it comes from Hashem Yisbarach,
and he is handed over to happenstance.
when Yehudah related these things to Yosef:
אָז לֹא הָיָה כְּלָל שְׁעַת סַכָּנָה
then there was no time of danger at all,
for he knew that Binyamin had done nothing,
but they had come at him with a pretext;
with a heh, without an aleph:
for it is mere happenstance and pretext.
which is a barking, accusing dog,
even where there is no danger
and even where there is no judgment upon them,
and this is the root of the kelipos,
and it is the inner part
of the kelipah of ox and donkey,
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 65a).
And to be saved from this it is written (Devarim 25:19),
"And it shall be, when Hashem your God gives you rest
בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ נוֹתֵן לְךָ
in the land that Hashem your God gives you":
"when He gives rest," and "in the land."
בְּיוֹם הָנִיחַ ה׳ לְךָ מֵעָצְבְּךָ וְגוֹ׳ (יְשַׁעְיָה יד, ג)
"On the day Hashem gives you rest from your toil, etc." (Yeshayahu 14:3)
as referring to the day of Shabbos:
even when he is still in hard labor,
for he knows that it is only from Hashem Yisbarach,
"And I will set My throne in Eilam";
and Hashem Yisbarach Himself is the one who leads,
and there is no subjugation here apart from Him.
Yisrael are as in the Land,
"Who spreads a sukkah of peace over us
וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם
and over all His people Yisrael and over Yerushalayim";
and as is written in the Responsa of the Geonim,
that this is why we do not say on Shabbos
for when the king is in his own country,
Yisrael are considered to be in the Land.
And especially at the third meal,
which corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְגוֹ׳ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כח, יד)
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward, etc." (Bereishis 28:14):
the holiness of Eretz Yisrael goes with him.
That is why we say at this meal,
when the Jew wills it on his part,
as they said (in Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei):
and I erase his name above."
That is why we say in this prayer,
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him:
"You are One and Your Name is One,
and who is like Your people Yisrael, one nation";
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
"That works for the Holy One, blessed is He,
From what is written, 'one nation in the land' (Shmuel II 7:23), etc."
וְכֵן זִיוּוּג קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
And likewise the union of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah
once the kingdom of Esav is judged,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג עז, ב)
and afterward 'and the kingship shall be Hashem's';
and after they are united as one,
וְהָיָה ה׳ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ וְגוֹ׳
'And Hashem shall be King over all the earth, etc.:
ה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד (זְכַרְיָה יד, ט)
Hashem shall be One and His Name One' (Zechariah 14:9)."
That is why we say in this prayer,
שֶׁהִיא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"You are One and Your Name is One,
and who is like Your people Yisrael,

Danger Accusation and the Meaning of Chance
Rest in the Land Brings Complete Oneness

— “For liberators shall march up on Mount Zion to wreak judgment on Mount Esau; and dominion shall be GOD’s.”

footnotes.heAnchorPrefix: וְהָיָה ה׳ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ וְגוֹ׳

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Pesachim 50a — “״והיה ה׳ למלך על כל הארץ ביום ההוא יהיה ה׳ אחד ושמו אחד״. אטו האידנא לאו אחד הוא?” — “The Gemara cites another verse from the prophecy at the end of the book of Zechariah: “And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day shall the Lord be one and His name one” (Zechariah 14:9). …”

rich.text: “״והיה ה׳ למלך על כל הארץ ביום ההוא יהיה ה׳ אחד ושמו אחד״. אטו האידנא לאו אחד הוא?”

— “The Gemara cites another verse from the prophecy at the end of the book of Zechariah: “And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day shall the Lord be one and His name one” (Zechariah 14:9). …”

footnotes.heAnchorPrefix: ה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד (זְכַרְיָה יד, ט)

paragraphs.text: Source: Zechariah 14:9 — “והיה יהוה למלך על כל הארץ ביום ההוא יהיה יהוה אחד ושמו אחד” — “And GOD shall be sovereign over all the earth; in that day there shall be one GOD with one name.fone GOD with one name I.e., GOD alone shall be worshiped—and shall be invoked by that name only.”
